lessons.title: Input and state
lessons.question: What happens when input arrives, then goes quiet?
lessons.suggestedAction: Inspect active input, then continue into the quiet interval.
lessons.expected: State responds to input and decays during quiet steps.
lessons.modelExpected: State responds to input and decays during quiet steps.
lessons.limitation: This reduced reservoir is a numerical mechanism, not a model of subjective experience.

lessons.title: Recurrence
lessons.question: What changes when preceding state contributes?
lessons.suggestedAction: Compare the matched states at steps 1 and 2.
lessons.expected: The first state difference appears at step 2.
lessons.modelExpected: The first state difference appears at step 2.
lessons.limitation: A state difference demonstrates this intervention, not better writing.

lessons.title: Sensory observer
lessons.question: What can a separate sensory field measure?
lessons.suggestedAction: Inspect the measured spectrum and the matched reservoir states.
lessons.expected: A sensory spectrum appears while reservoir state remains matched.
lessons.modelExpected: A sensory spectrum appears while reservoir state remains matched.
lessons.limitation: Input feeds the reservoir and sensory field in parallel; the field does not measure reservoir coordinates.

lessons.title: Journal output
lessons.question: What information becomes a journal?
lessons.suggestedAction: Continue to step 30 and read the prompt, reply and saved journal.
lessons.expected: A journal is saved at step 30; writing alone leaves reservoir state unchanged.
lessons.modelExpected: A recorded model response becomes a saved journal at the writing opportunity.
lessons.limitation: Scripted words qualify transport. A single model run does not measure the causal effect of writing.

lessons.title: Reservoir return
lessons.question: When does a saved journal change the next input?
lessons.suggestedAction: Inspect the journal at 30, then Step once to 31.
lessons.expected: The journal saved at 30 first returns to the reservoir at 31.
lessons.modelExpected: The saved journal is encoded and first applied on the following step.
lessons.limitation: The return vector is a numerical encoding; it does not preserve recoverable journal text.

lessons.title: Journal memory
lessons.question: Where does an earlier journal enter the next prompt?
lessons.suggestedAction: Read the journal at 30, then its memory inclusion at 60.
lessons.expected: The earlier journal enters the prepared prompt at 60; fixed replies remain fixed.
lessons.modelExpected: An earlier saved journal is included in the later submitted prompt.
lessons.limitation: Exposure is not proof of understanding. These single-arm model recordings do not establish a memory benefit.

lessons.title: Action choice
lessons.question: Can a writing opportunity end without a journal?
lessons.suggestedAction: Inspect the choice at 90 and its actual outcome.
lessons.expected: The scripted choice is WAIT at 90; no new journal is saved.
lessons.modelExpected: Inspect the actual recorded choices. Writing at every opportunity is a valid outcome.
lessons.limitation: A scripted WAIT demonstrates mechanics, not spontaneous model preference. Keep every actual outcome.

lessons.title: Regulation
lessons.question: What can the retention controller change, and where does it reach a limit?
lessons.suggestedAction: Compare fill and retention, then inspect the separate sustained-input example.
lessons.expected: Retention and sensory measurements change; the controller may reach its limit.
lessons.modelExpected: Inspect the recorded fill, retention and controller decisions.
lessons.limitation: This short example demonstrates activity and limits, not target attainment. The separate 600-step example tests mean target error under declared sustained input.
